_comment: Render settings for the Docker-pinned Mermaid render step.
Read by tidepool_data_science_simulator.diagramgen.render; every value here is
recorded, with this file's SHA-256, in manifest.json's render block.
image: digest-pinned, never a tag. The digest fixes @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli, the
resolved mermaid, puppeteer, the Chromium build and the Alpine font set together.
A tag-only reference is rejected outright rather than warned about. Resolved from
ghcr.io tag 11.17.1 -- note the tag and the packaged version disagree upstream
(that tag ships mermaid-cli-11.17.0.tgz), which is why the manifest records
versions read out of the running container rather than restating them here.
width_px: the pixel width the PNG must come out at. mmdc has no flag that sets an
output width -- --width caps the viewport and --scale multiplies the natural layout
size -- so the render step measures each figure and derives the scale that hits this
target. A scale factor fixed here instead would give a different width, and a
different effective DPI, every time the traced graph changed. 2700 targets a
landscape full-width placement at 300 DPI, 2000 a portrait one: data_flow is a
flowchart LR and lays out wide, timestep_sequence is a sequence diagram and lays out
tall. SVG outputs carry no width_px -- mermaid-cli emits a responsive root, so a
vector has no pixel width to pin.
reproducibility_level: what the integration suite asserts when the same .mmd is
rendered twice with this image. Set to 'bytes' on 2026-09-22 after measurement:
five renders of each committed figure on macOS arm64 / Docker 29.8.0 produced one
distinct SHA-256 per figure. Lower it back to 'dimensions' if a host is found
where that does not hold. See the generator README.
